The quote is there word for word: "It will take no more than 4 years to have fully autonomous cars on the road. How long it takes for the vast majority of cars on the road to become that, it really just depends," Huang told media after a company event in Taipei. The post says he spoke "on Thursday", and 26 October 2017 was a Thursday, so the candidate's date matches. This is news coverage, not Huang's own post, a transcript or a printed question-and-answer.

**2. The four parts of the rule.**

The second sentence ("it really just depends") has no date and is not a claim, but it doesn't cancel the first.
- **Part 3 (date or span): met.** "No more than 4 years" from 26 October 2017 runs to October 2021, so it would be judged at the end of 2021.
